gaps.name: Connecticut River crossing
gaps.note: No pedestrian crossing exists. Northbound the trail resumes on Old Mountain Road near Skinner State Park; southbound at 2-98 Underwood Ave, Easthampton MA. Hikers arrange a boat or car ride across; the road detour via US-5N and MA-47N is 10.2mi and not recommended (high traffic).
